Agent Name: DataVerification_Expert
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The verifier prematurely concluded only Yosemite Falls qualifies, misusing the criterion by accepting vague “multiple sources” instead of confirming at least three different people and failing to broaden the candidate set to include Bridalveil Fall. By asserting a final conclusion and issuing termination, this step made the earlier omission irrecoverable and directly led to the incomplete answer.

The Subtask Name: Building Task
Agents_edges:
- From_agent: Orchestrator
  To_agent: InformationExtraction_Expert
  agent_dependency_type: decision_dependency
  agent_strength: 0.86

      description: Misstating the objectives or criteria for the information search during planning.
      severity: 0.70
      if_from_agent_wrong: The expert will target the wrong sites/criteria (e.g., wrong review thresholds or locations).
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The InformationExtraction_Expert’s queries and extracted trails will be misaligned from the outset.
    - type: irrecoverability_issue
      description: Omission of the accessibility-by-3-people requirement in the planning brief.
      severity: 0.80
      if_from_agent_wrong: The expert might not collect evidence tailored to that constraint.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: Subsequent verification may lack necessary inputs, forcing rework or leading to incomplete answers.

- From_agent: Orchestrator
  To_agent: Python_Programming_Expert
  agent_dependency_type: decision_dependency
  agent_strength: 0.55

  agent_failure_modes:
    - type: loop_issue
      description: Planning to use computation where unnecessary may lead to redundant steps.
      severity: 0.30
      if_from_agent_wrong: The Orchestrator could allocate tasks that add no value for this problem.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: The Python_Programming_Expert might await data or perform superfluous processing, delaying progress.
    - type: data_issue
      description: Mischaracterizing the kind of data to be processed (e.g., expecting datasets instead of web evidence).

      likely_effect_on_to_agent: Confusion or idle time due to mismatch with actual task needs.

- From_agent: Orchestrator

  agent_strength: 0.84

  agent_failure_modes:

      description: Incomplete or vague verification criteria in the plan (e.g., not specifying “at least three different people”).
      severity: 0.75
      if_from_agent_wrong: The Checker may validate against weaker or different standards.
      likely_effect_on_to_agent: Leads to acceptance of trails that don’t meet the necessary bar or rejection of valid ones.
    - type: irrecoverability_issue
      description: Planning omits the requirement to use TripAdvisor review counts.
      severity: 0.65

- From_agent: DataVerification_Expert
